# ThinkAI UI

> Source-owned UI, motion, and icon primitives for React and Next.js.

## Documentation

- [Documentation](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs): installation, accessibility, roadmap, and contribution guidance.
- [Installation](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/installation): initialize and add source-owned primitives.
- [Accessibility](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/accessibility): semantic controls, keyboard behavior, and reduced motion.
- [Roadmap](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/roadmap): planned library and docs improvements.
- [Changelog](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/changelog): shipped changes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/troubleshooting): registry, theme, and motion guidance.

## Library

- [UI primitives](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/ui): application controls and surfaces.
- [Motion primitives](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/motion): purposeful transitions and effects.
- [Icons](https://ui.thinkai.studio/docs/icons): factual technology marks and accessible icon controls.
- [Catalog](https://ui.thinkai.studio/catalog): composed showcase patterns.

## Registry

- [Registry index](https://ui.thinkai.studio/r/registry.json): installable source manifests.
- Install a primitive with `npx thinkai-ui add <slug>`.
- Source is copied into the consuming project and remains editable there.
